n = int(input())
budget = int(input())

array = [0] * (n + 1)
evenPrefix = [0] * (n + 1)
oddPrefix = [0] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    array[i] = int(input())
    if array[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenPrefix[i] = evenPrefix[i - 1] + 1
        oddPrefix[i] = oddPrefix[i - 1]
    else:
        oddPrefix[i] = oddPrefix[i - 1] + 1
        evenPrefix[i] = evenPrefix[i - 1]

cuts = []

for j in range(2, n):
    diff = abs(array[j] - array[j + 1])
    if evenPrefix[j] == oddPrefix[j]:
        cuts.append(diff)

cuts.sort()

count = 0
for c in cuts:
    if budget >= c:
        budget -= c
        count += 1
    else:
        break

print(count)
